title: AI DJs Completely Kill My Groove
summary: YouTube Music and Spotify want synthetic hosts to curate your playlists. Their awkward banter and bogus song trivia are ruining the vibe.
llm_summary: YouTube Music and Spotify are rolling out AI‑generated hosts to act as “DJs,” offering commentary, trivia and playlist curation. While the tech sounds slick, many listeners find the scripted banter and inaccurate facts jarring, turning what should be a seamless music experience into a distracting, low‑budget vibe. The move highlights the growing tension between automation’s convenience and the human touch that keeps music listening enjoyable.
